authority: Joint adopted 2026–2027 OER, VU 26 May and UvA 9 June 2026. Articles 9.1, 10.2, 11.1, 11.3–6 and 12.1 and the Dutch grid on pp. 24–25 control the 48+12 and 48+30+30+12 EC allocations. The grid assigns Classical Mythology to period 4 and Seminar Ancient History to period 5. It shows 6 EC for Classical Canon 2 and 12 EC for thesis with colloquium. The Study Guide confirms the joint structure and five specialisations. Ancient History illustrates the common core without borrowing specialist units from other routes.
